description: Runs the Android Automotive build of Google Maps (26.10.120003.E) on BYD DiLink 3 head units (Android 10) with MicroG-RE 7.3.0: sign-in, map, search, navigation and voice (with the head unit's text-to-speech voice when Google's online voice has none), Home and Work in the icons under the search box, a small Maps window during guidance when another app covers Maps, UI density, language, driver side and color scheme settings, 3D buildings in the map layers, the main map's colors and layers on the cluster map where Maps shows one, the car's battery for EV routing (on by default on the tested BYD Dolphin and on BYD model ids 128 and 138) and the battery to arrive with at charging stops and at the destination, the battery percentage and energy model for Google Maps on your phone (on by default; a switch turns it off), Send to car from phone Maps with a car name you choose, an in-app problem report that is sent only after you review it, a daily check for a newer release, and a safe mode with feature switches. The app is named "Maps" unless you set another name in the App name option. BYD battery, Send to car, the BYD location flicker fix, BYD GPS interval, BYD navigation volume, 3D buildings, Navigation speech, Home and Work shortcuts and Floating Maps window are separate patches. Requires Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer.
